info.title: Tag Component Skill
info.description: Label a stable, descriptive attribute with a decorative colour theme, optionally as a two-part key/value pair with an icon and a dismiss action

post.description: Generate or validate a Tag component instance with specified props

TagProps.description: Props for the Tag React component. Generated from the manifest — do not edit by hand.

variant.description: Fill treatment. 'outline' uses the theme's outline background and border; 'secondary' uses its filled secondary background.

size.description: Tag height and type scale. 'sm' also shrinks the action button from size '2xs' to '3xs'.

theme.description: Decorative colour name, not a semantic status. Three values resolve to semantic colour sets internally: green→success, red→danger, yellow→warning. The prop value is still the colour name.

value.description: The tag's text, and the only required prop. In a single tag it renders as {value || label}; in a split tag it is the right-hand half.

icon.description: An IconV2 name, rendered at size 'xs' before the text. In split mode it is applied to the left tag only — the right tag never takes a tag icon.

label.description: Passing label *and* value switches rendering to an internal two-tag split composite: label on the left, value on the right. Passing label alone renders a single tag whose text is the label. This mode switch is silent and changes which other props are honoured (see knownGaps).

iconProps.description: An IconPropsV2 object passed through to IconV2, excluding name, size, fallback and ref. Dropped entirely in split mode — Tag does not forward it to the split composite.

actionIcon.description: An IconV2 name rendered inside a transparent icon-only Button after the text — the dismiss/remove affordance. In split mode it is applied to the right tag only.

onActionClick.description: Fires on the action button. The handler calls stopPropagation() and preventDefault() first, so an action click never also triggers the tag's own onClick.

onClick.description: Inherited from React.HTMLAttributes rather than declared, so it does not appear in TagProps' own members. Its presence implies hover styling and cursor-pointer. It is the one inherited attribute forwarded into split mode, where it is attached to both halves.

enableHover.description: Applies hover styling to a non-clickable tag. Ignored in split mode: the split path overwrites it with Boolean(onClick), so a hoverable split tag requires an onClick.

rounded.description: Switches the corner radius from the default to a full pill. In split mode the outer corners round and the shared inner edge stays square.

disabled.description: Visual and cursor state only — it is not a CVA variant and sets no aria-disabled. The tag is a div, so there is nothing for it to disable; onClick still fires. It does disable the action Button.

title.description: Native tooltip on the text span, defaulting to title || value || label so truncated text is always recoverable on hover. Dropped in split mode, where each half falls back to its own text.

className.description: Additional classes on the tag root, or on the split wrapper in split mode. Should not override token-based styling.

labelClassName.description: Classes for the left half of a split tag. No effect on a single tag.

valueClassName.description: Classes for the right half of a split tag. No effect on a single tag.

keyboardSupport: Tab — reaches the action button only, when actionIcon is set
Enter / Space — activates the focused action button
No keyboard path to the tag itself; role and tabIndex are omitted from TagProps and cannot be supplied
x-accessibility.notes: A single tag is a plain div with no role, so it is announced as text. The type deliberately omits 'role' and 'tabIndex', which means a Tag with onClick cannot be made keyboard-operable or announced as a control from the outside — use Button for anything that must be actionable. The action button is a real <button> and is focusable, but it renders with ignoreIconOnlyTooltip and an unlabelled icon, so it has no accessible name.

x-known-gaps: TAG-001: A clickable Tag is not keyboard-operable. The type omits 'role' and 'tabIndex', so no consumer can fix it from outside — use Button when the thing must be actionable
TAG-002: The action button has no accessible name. It renders iconOnly with ignoreIconOnlyTooltip and an unlabelled icon, and Tag exposes no prop to label it

TAG-003: Split mode drops most inherited attributes. Passing label + value forwards only onClick to the split composite, so id, data-*, aria-*, title, iconProps and other HTMLAttributes are silently discarded
TAG-004: Split mode overrides enableHover with Boolean(onClick), so a caller's enableHover is ignored there
TAG-005: 'forest-green' and 'lime' exist in code but not in the Figma component's theme variant, so a design cannot specify them and Code Connect cannot produce them
TAG-006: 'children' is accepted by the inherited HTMLAttributes type but never rendered — the text comes from value/label only
TAG-007: 'disabled' sets no aria-disabled and does not stop onClick; it is visual state only
